What does Auctech Marcom do?

Auctech Marketing Communication Pvt. Ltd. (Auctech Marcom) is a marketing communication company in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. We provide AI automation and smart CRM, website design and custom software development, mobile app development, brand identity design, and digital brand strategy, digital marketing and SEO for businesses across India.

##

How do we start a project with you?

Reach out by phone, email or the contact form. We begin with a discovery conversation to understand your goals, then agree the scope, deliverables and timeline before work begins.

##

Do you work with small and growing businesses?

Yes. Many of our solutions are configured around tools you already use, so the approach can be scaled to the size and budget of the business.

##

Where are you located?

Our office is at 167, Flat 101, Shaligram Apartment, New Jiamau Road, Hazratganj, Lucknow – 226001, India. We work with clients across India.

# AI Automation & Smart CRM Services in Lucknow, India | Auctech Marcom
URL: https://auctech.in/service-ai-automation.html
Summary: Website chatbots, automated lead capture and routing, appointment reminders and CRM workflow automation with HubSpot, Zoho, Zapier and Make. Practical, transparent AI for Indian businesses.

# AI Automation & Smart CRM

AI automation, chatbots and smart CRM workflows that help Indian businesses reduce repetitive work and respond to leads faster.

Set up website chatbots, automated lead capture and routing, appointment reminders, CRM connections and internal workflows. Automations are documented and designed to keep people involved in decisions that require human judgment.

## Key features of this service

- Trained website chatbots

- Automated lead routing

- CRM workflow automation

- Clear documentation and handoff

## Standards & benefits

Practical, transparent AI use

Automation built around existing tools

Human review for judgment-based decisions

Ongoing support after launch

## Our process

### step 01

### Map where the team loses time

We review how enquiries, follow-ups and routine tasks currently move through your team and identify where automation will save the most time.

### step 02

### Train the chatbot and build workflows

The chatbot is trained on your business information and the lead-capture, routing and reminder workflows are built around the tools you already use.

### step 03

### Connect the CRM and test

HubSpot or Zoho CRM is connected, every workflow is tested end to end, and anything that needs human judgment is routed to a person.

### step 04

### Launch, document and support

We go live, hand over clear documentation and stay available for support and refinements after launch.

## Technologies & tools

- OpenAI API and LLM-based chatbots

- HubSpot and Zoho CRM

- Zapier and Make

- Website chat widgets

## Frequently asked questions

##

Do we need a large technology budget?

Not necessarily. Many solutions use existing AI tools and platforms configured for the business.

##

Will a chatbot replace our team?

No. It can handle common questions and initial lead capture, then pass complex requests to a person.

##

Which CRM tools can be connected?

Common options include HubSpot and Zoho CRM, with workflow connections through Zapier or Make.

# Website Design & Software Development

Plan, design and develop user-friendly websites and digital products tailored to business needs. The approach emphasizes responsive layouts, clean code, scalability, security, performance and maintainability.

## Our process

### Discovery and planning

We understand your business goals, content, users and technical needs, then agree the scope, sitemap and timeline.

### step 02

### Wireframes and design

Page structures are mapped out first, then designed as responsive layouts that work on phones, tablets and desktops.

### step 03

### Development and quality assurance

The site or application is built with clean, maintainable code and tested for performance, security and cross-device compatibility.

### step 04

### Launch and post-launch support

# Mobile App Development Services in India | Auctech
URL: https://auctech.in/service-mobile-app-development.html
Summary: Build user-friendly Android and iOS apps with custom UI/UX, cross-platform development, analytics and ongoing improvement from Auctech.

# Mobile App Development

Android, iOS and cross-platform mobile apps that help Indian businesses serve customers, simplify tasks and strengthen their digital presence.

We design and develop mobile applications that help businesses serve customers, simplify everyday tasks and strengthen their digital presence. Whether you need an Android app, an iOS app or a cross-platform solution, we shape the product around your users, goals and operational needs.

## Key features of this service

- Custom UI/UX design: User flows, wireframes and interface designs built around the tasks people need to complete.

- Business-specific functionality: Features planned for the app’s purpose, from customer accounts and forms to booking or workflow features where required.

- Cross-platform compatibility: A shared Android and iOS implementation when appropriate for the product and technical requirements.

- API and system integration: Connections to approved websites, databases, payment services, CRM platforms or other systems where supported and scoped.

- App analytics: Event tracking and reporting options to understand usage and identify improvements, subject to consent and privacy requirements.

- Testing and quality checks: Functional, usability, device and integration testing based on the agreed scope.

- Release preparation: Support with store assets, listing information and submission steps where included in the engagement.

- Maintenance and enhancement: Bug fixes, compatibility updates and new features under an agreed support or maintenance plan.

## Solutions for Android and iOS

### Android App Development

We plan Android experiences around your audience and the devices they use. Work can include screen design, navigation, forms, notifications, account features and connections to approved APIs or business systems. Device and usability testing helps identify issues before release. Google Play publishing support can be included when agreed in the project scope.

### iOS App Development

We design iPhone and, where required, iPad experiences with clear navigation, responsive interactions and consistent visual design. Implementation is planned around required iOS features, security needs and integrations. App Store submission preparation and release assistance can be provided according to the agreed scope.

### Cross-Platform App Development

For suitable projects, a cross-platform approach can help deliver Android and iOS versions from a shared codebase. This can reduce duplicated effort, while still requiring checks for device-specific behaviour, performance and platform conventions. The right choice depends on feature complexity, budget, delivery goals and future plans.

## Standards & benefits

A convenient way for customers to access your services on mobile devices.

A consistent brand experience across key digital touchpoints.

Simpler digital journeys for common customer or staff tasks.

A technical foundation that can be extended as needs evolve.

Better visibility into agreed usage and engagement measures when analytics are implemented.

Clear project documentation and a defined handover process.

User-centred experience: Design decisions are guided by user needs, task clarity and straightforward navigation.

Appropriate technology choices: Native or cross-platform development is selected based on requirements rather than a one-size-fits-all rule.

Security and privacy awareness: Data collection, permissions, access and third-party services are considered during planning and implementation.

Test before release: Core flows and supported devices are checked against agreed acceptance criteria.

Transparent scope: Features, assumptions, dependencies, timelines and responsibilities are documented before development begins.

Maintainable delivery: Handover documentation helps the client understand and maintain the solution where included.

## Our process

### step 01

### Discovery and requirements

Discuss business goals, users, essential features, constraints and success measures.

### step 02

### Product structure and UI/UX

Map user journeys and prepare wireframes or prototypes for review.

### step 03

### Technical planning

Confirm platform approach, architecture, integrations, data needs and milestones.

### step 04

### Development

Build agreed features in manageable stages and review progress with the client.

### step 05

### Testing and refinement

Check functionality, usability, device behaviour and integrations; address agreed issues.

### step 06

### Release and handover

Prepare for store submission or deployment, provide documentation and transfer relevant access.

### step 07

### Support and improvement

Review feedback and performance, then plan maintenance or enhancements under the agreed arrangement.

## Technologies & tools

- Android and iOS development tools for platform-specific applications

- Flutter or React Native for suitable cross-platform projects

- Figma or comparable design tools for wireframes and interface prototypes

- APIs and backend services for data exchange and application logic

- Analytics and crash-reporting tools where appropriate and approved

- Version control, testing and deployment workflows suited to the project

## Frequently asked questions

##

Do you develop apps for both Android and iOS?

Yes, a project can be planned for Android, iOS or both. The recommended approach depends on features, budget and release goals.

##

Should we choose native or cross-platform development?

Native development can suit apps requiring deeper platform-specific capabilities. Cross-platform development may be efficient when a shared codebase meets the product’s needs. We recommend an approach after reviewing requirements.

##

Can the app connect to our existing website or CRM?

Potentially. We review the existing system, available APIs, permissions and integration requirements. Compatibility depends on platforms and access available.

##

Will you help publish the app?

Store listing and submission assistance can be included in scope. Store approval is controlled by the relevant platform and cannot be guaranteed.

##

Can you maintain the app after launch?

Maintenance can be arranged separately or included in a support plan. It may cover agreed bug fixes, compatibility updates, monitoring and enhancements.

# Brand Identity Design Services in Lucknow, India | Auctech Marcom
URL: https://auctech.in/service-brand-identity.html
Summary: Logo design, colour palettes, typography, positioning and documented brand guidelines. Brand identity design that makes Indian businesses recognisable across digital and print.

# Brand Identity Design

Brand identity services that help Indian businesses define their personality, build trust and maintain a consistent visual presence.

Develop a cohesive identity beyond the logo, including colour palettes, typography, imagery and visual guidelines. The aim is to make the business recognizable and consistent across digital and print channels.

## Key features of this service

- Brand discovery and research

- Positioning and messaging

- Logo and visual identity design

- Brand guidelines delivery

## Standards & benefits

Strategic positioning

Flexible visual assets

Documented brand guidelines

Consistent use across channels

## Our process

### step 01

### Brand discovery and research

We explore your business, audience, competitors and ambitions to understand what the brand needs to communicate.

### step 02

### Positioning and messaging

The brand's personality, positioning and core messages are defined so the visual identity has a clear foundation.

### step 03

### Logo and visual identity design

Logo concepts, colour palettes, typography and imagery styles are designed and refined into a cohesive identity.

### step 04

### Delivery of brand guidelines

Source files and a documented brand guideline are delivered so the identity stays consistent across digital and print.

## Technologies & tools

- Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

- Typography and colour systems

- Brand guideline documentation

- Print and digital asset production

## Frequently asked questions

##

How many logo concepts are included?

The number of initial concepts should be confirmed in the project scope.

##

What files can be delivered?

Deliverables may include source files such as AI, SVG and PNG, plus a brand guideline document, as agreed.

##

Can you refresh an existing brand?

Yes. A refresh can modernize the identity while preserving useful existing recognition.

##

Does branding include more than a logo?

A broader brand kit can include colours, typography, guidelines and stationery templates.

Store listing and submission assistance can be included in scope. Store approval is controlled by the relevant platform and cannot be guaranteed.

##

Can you maintain the app after launch?

Maintenance can be arranged separately or included in a support plan. It may cover agreed bug fixes, compatibility updates, monitoring and enhancements.
